home.aboutSummary: Architecture graduate of Drexel's 2+4 program, now managing adaptive reuse projects in Philadelphia. Most motivated by constraint-heavy problems and the creative solutions they demand.

paragraphs: Driven architecture graduate of the 2+4 program at Drexel University. A quick learner interested in implementing innovative and creative techniques in designing inclusive, community-oriented projects.

My strengths lie in early design and conceptual development — diagramming, rendering, and clearly conveying intent. I excel at communication and presentation, translating complex ideas into clear, compelling narratives. I am most motivated when tackling constraint-heavy problems, and most fulfilled when crafting creative, unique solutions.

I am seeking a civically minded, challenging role that prioritises sustainability and community while providing opportunities to broaden my skills. I aim to help positively transform Philadelphia's built environment.

timeline.title: Project Manager / Designer, Philly Office Retail
timeline.detail: Adaptive reuse and state-of-good-repair projects from design through construction. Coordinating architects, contractors and consultants, overseeing budgets and schedules, leading RFPs and negotiations.

timeline.title: Designer, WRT Planning + Design
timeline.detail: Large-scale affordable mixed-use projects from proposal to 90% CDs. Research on biophilic design and energy modelling for carbon-negative communities, and renderings across housing and education projects.

timeline.title: Bachelor of Architecture, Drexel University
timeline.detail: Philadelphia, PA. Pearson Prize Silver Medal for best Drexel architectural thesis project.

timeline.title: LEED Green Associate
timeline.detail: One examination away from licensure as a Registered Architect in Pennsylvania.
